description: This Kotlin source file defines the ShareAPI interface for interacting with sharing functionalities in the Nextcloud Notes Android client. It includes methods for creating, retrieving, updating, and deleting shares, as well as sending emails and fetching share details related to notes or items.

methods.name: getSharees
methods.description: Retrieves a list of sharees with search options, defaulting to JSON format and item type 'file'.

methods.name: getShares
methods.description: Fetches share details for a specific remote ID, including tags by default.

methods.name: getSharesForSpecificNote
methods.description: Retrieves shares related to a specific note path, including reshares and subfiles.

methods.name: removeShare
methods.description: Deletes a share identified by share ID.

methods.name: addShare
methods.description: Creates a new share with the specified request details.

methods.name: sendEmail
methods.description: Sends an email regarding a share, optionally including a password.

methods.name: updateShare
methods.description: Updates the details of an existing share.

methods.name: updateSharePermission
methods.description: Updates permissions for a specific share.

methods.name: getShareFromNote
methods.description: Retrieves shares associated with a note, including shares shared with the current user.
